description.narrative:
The overall goal of the project is social and economic empowerment of women through three main outcomes;
(1) Transitioning women informal workers to formal sector through improved access to resources and law and policy implementation. Through the project's initiatives, skilled women will successfully transition into formal employment, supported by an enabling environment that promotes gender equality. This integration will contribute to sustainable economic growth and serve as a model for empowering women in the workforce, including those with disabilities.
(2) Increased women’s participation in the Digital Sphere. By the end of the project, women home-based workers will have transitioned into entrepreneurs, utilizing digital technology and sustainable value chain models. These empowered women entrepreneurs will not only achieve financial independence but also inspire and mentor others, resulting in a network of women entrepreneurs within their communities. The project will build capacities of women in a range of sectors to adopt technological solutions for day-to-day business operations.
(3) Influencing Policies to Enhancing Women and Girls’ Economic Leadership and Resilience. Through the project’s initiatives, vulnerable and marginalized women in the formal and informal sectors, including those with disabilities, will be empowered to enhance their economic resilience and leadership capabilities, by building partnerships with key stakeholders, including government institutions, civil society, private sector entities, and local communities, and through strategic advocacy efforts and collaborations.
